text: The bay between Blablania and Feisis (review T11): below its mouth the two coasts run a single pixel of paper apart for ~250 km, and the tracer's blur read that pixel as land. Fixed by authored sea strokes, cut from the finished land mask so nothing else moves — a one-pixel strait is past what any general rule can tell from two coasts touching. Every other ring shifted under 20 m.
